panels.title: File integrity coverage and evidence limits

options.content: **No verified file integrity event feed is connected to Prometheus.** Missing data here means uncollected or unexposed, not zero changes. Wazuh/auditd process presence alone does not prove watched paths, event delivery, or alert coverage.

panels.title: Prometheus targets related to audit and file integrity
panels.description: Only scrape target health for jobs whose names indicate audit, Wazuh, FIM, Filebeat, Loki, or Alloy. No rows means no matching scrape target was found; it does not mean there were no file changes.

options.content: Read-only host checks found `auditd.service` active and the Wazuh agent plus `wazuh-syscheckd` processes running. These are service/process observations only. The auditd journal reports **No plugins found, not dispatching events**. The current account cannot read Wazuh configuration/logs or inspect audit rules with `auditctl`, so watched paths, audit rule coverage, event forwarding, and manager connectivity are **unverified**. Prometheus currently has no matching audit/Wazuh/FIM scrape target and no Wazuh file-integrity event metric.

panels.title: Collection scope and next evidence needed

options.content: Before treating this dashboard as coverage, verify Wazuh `syscheck` watched paths and exclusions, agent-to-manager connectivity, and where resulting events are retained. Review auditd rules and event dispatch separately. Export only bounded event counts/status to Prometheus; retain detailed evidence in the source system. Protect database files, audit logs, backups, monitoring configuration, and selected project files according to an approved scope.
